candidates.rationale: The ad service reports the underlying UNAVAILABLE error when processing GetAds requests, which propagates up to frontend components.
The frontend service handles API routes and fails when calling dependent services, though it is primarily a symptom container.
The frontend-proxy router encounters errors during egress routing as a result of downstream failures.
The frontend service frequently fails while executing RecommendationService calls and logging API request failures.
The frontend-proxy experiences egress routing errors leading to failures in downstream frontend API calls.
The frontend-web service shows GET error spans reflecting user-facing issues originating from the frontend stack.
The checkout service calls PaymentService and fails, propagating the error back to the frontend.
The frontend reports the API checkout failure logs, but acts as an aggregator of downstream errors.
Frontend proxy handles ingress routing and shows errors only as a symptom of the underlying checkout failure.
frontend-proxy is the edge service capturing the earliest and most frequent error spans before propagating requests to frontend-web.
frontend-web shows downstream error spans shortly after incoming requests fail at the proxy.
General frontend processing could be the underlying origin of the request failures seen at the edge proxy.
The ad service is continuously performing full garbage collections, indicating memory pressure or a memory leak.
No errors or symptoms were logged for frontend during this time.
No issues or errors were reported for cart.
Checkout service fails during PlaceOrder and calls CartService, propagating errors up to frontend and proxy.
Frontend fails executing api route /api/checkout and triggers downstream checkout calls, acting as an intermediate layer.
Frontend-proxy shows frequent GET and POST errors as the entry point reflecting overall system degradation.
Cart logs explicitly report a failure to connect to redis, causing downstream failures in checkout and frontend-proxy.
Checkout experiences spans failing to empty carts, but this is secondary to the cart service connection issue.
Frontend-proxy only shows symptoms of failing HTTP requests caused by backend errors.
Payment service logs explicitly show payment failures due to invalid tokens.
Checkout service handles the order placement and propagates the failing payment requests.
Frontend initiates the user checkout API route which subsequently fails down the chain.
Recommendation service logs errors regarding logger initialization provider issues while frontend calls fail on recommendation routes.
Frontend shows API request failures and failing recommendation spans, but these are downstream symptoms of recommendation failures.
Proxy records routing errors for GET requests, which reflect the underlying recommendation failures.
The product-catalog service is the deepest downstream dependency showing error spans in all traced call stacks.
The frontend service aggregates API requests and fails to handle downstream calls properly.
The frontend-proxy shows egress router errors routing user requests.
